title: Changing the Parts representative never changes the Labor one
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: An open work order has the same person as its Labor and Parts representative, and you change only the Parts person.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", both reading {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "Sales Representative - Parts".
  2. Click {Sales-rep-B} in the dropdown.
  3. Click "Sales Representative - Labor".
  4. Click "Unassigned" in the dropdown.
  5. Reload the page.
  6. Click "Sales Representative - Labor".
  7. Click {Sales-rep-B} in the dropdown.
  8. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the dropdown opens.
  • Step 2: Parts reads {Sales-rep-B}; Labor still reads {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 3: the dropdown opens.
  • Step 4: Labor reads "Unassigned"; Parts still reads {Sales-rep-B}. Labor is not handed to {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 5: Labor reads "Unassigned" and Parts reads {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 6: the dropdown opens.
  • Step 7: both fields read {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 8: both fields still show after the reload and both read {Sales-rep-B}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R11: “Each of the two fields works as S1-R2 to S1-R15.”
  • S2-R12: “Picking in one field never changes the other.”
  • S2-N1: “A side is never refilled on its own. Setting one side to "Unassigned" never hands that side to the other person and never fills it from the customer after the work order is created (S4-R24, S4-R28).”
  • S2-R15: “The work order keeps both fields when the page is reloaded or reopened, including when both hold the same person.”
